combo_label: The Office × Taylor Swift × The Wizard of Oz

entries.clue: Rusted, hollow fellow who creaks to a halt until his oil can is found
Good witch who floats down in a bubble, crowned and gowned in spangled pink
Low-walled pen of grey fabric where a worker is parked all day
Celebratory fizz whose problems title one of her most wrenching piano ballads
Green gem that gives the glittering city at the end of the bricks its name
Quaking feeling the maned companion owns up to and hopes a humbug can cure
Career chapters, each given its own act in the stadium tour she ran from 2023
Flat workspace with drawers, its surface lost under paper and crumbs
Grey box that hums for hours, then jams the moment a deadline gets close
What goes around comes around, and she made a bouncy Midnights track of it
